scenarios.title: Real native module depletes exact rock before verified positive cargo ID
steps: Run strict physical miner on disposable Perimeter belt
Capture rock before/after, module/cycle ID, native cargo ID and amount
expected: Source delta equals normal + wasted; cargo delta equals transferred; both IDs remain original

scenarios.title: Asteroid state repo.write returns failure
steps: Inject gameStore source writer acknowledgement failure
Allow authentic native mining cycle
expected: No native cargo credited; UNCERTAIN journal and operator quarantine

scenarios.title: Crash after source cache mutation before durable disk flush
steps: Kill disposable server after source write acknowledgement, before flush
Restart from isolated unchanged disk
Inspect journal, source and cargo
expected: No automatic duplicate; any disagreement quarantined for repair

scenarios.title: Cargo write rejected after valid depletion
steps: Inject native cargo writer success=false
Attempt same miner/asteroid cycle twice
expected: No second source depletion; source remains quarantined for operator

scenarios.title: Cargo commits then throws
steps: Inject write-then-throw on native cargo
Restart disposable EveJS and retry miner
expected: No replayed cargoID nor second depletion without source-specific review

scenarios.title: Two miners competing for same rock
steps: Run two physical miners with separate modules/cycles
Inject uncertain debit in one while other attempts mining
expected: Unresolved rock is blocked regardless of miner; no overdraw

scenarios.title: Depleted rock/restart and missing persistent actor
steps: Mine to last resource unit
Crash at debit/credit boundaries
Restart and check rock destruction and NPC identity
expected: No rock restoration granting repeat cargo; unresolved identities quarantined

scenarios.title: Mine to hauler to real warehouse plus two authorized clients
steps: Mine real ore under strict flags
Transfer same native cargoID to actual NPC hauler
Dock station and settle original warehouse itemStore receipt
Observe same world with two authorized clients
expected: One source debit, one cargoID custody chain, one committed warehouse receipt, no invented ISK
